text.tspan: Share of boys enrolled in pre-primary school
Comparing net and gross enrollment ratios for boys in pre-primary education. Net enrollment shows the share
of boys of pre-primary school age (typically 3–5 years) who are enrolled, while gross enrollment includes all
boys regardless of age, expressed as a percentage of boys of the same age group.

tspan.tspan: UNESCO Institute for Statistics (2026); UNESCO Institute for Statistics (UIS), via World Bank (2026)
